items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: I told Don, I said, you killed him.

ctx.x: You know, she used to sit in the lobby. You know, when we were at the John Hotel, Don Peterson used to take exercise on the fire escape in the back, 13 floors above the ground. And he got that chintin on the floor. Well, he killed Frank Colomaz. His feet are hanging off

13 floors. He killed him. He got a heart attack after that. He told him, he says, you son of a bitch, it's white. I don't know what the argument was. He says, I'll throw you out on the roof. And he grabbed Colomaz and gone as powerful as an ox. And he put his head out the window. And Frank, oh no, Don, no, no, no, no. He says, don't you ever say anything like that anymore or something like that. And two days afterwards, he got a heart attack and died. I told Don, I said, you killed him. I said, you killed him the…
I think I got a lot of things I want to ask you. We've got the third reel on Frank Netto,
